class.name: NetwBitStream
class.brief_description: Writes and reads data bit by bit, with the same code.

method.name: align_verify
method.description: Pads with zeros to the next full byte. When reading, fails if the padding is not zero. Returns [code]false[/code] on failure.

method.name: bit_length
method.description: The number of bits written, read or counted so far.

method.name: bits
method.description: Writes the lowest [param count] bits of [param value], from [code]1[/code] to [code]64[/code]. When reading, returns the value read.

method.name: bits_remaining
method.description: The number of bits not read yet. Always [code]0[/code] when not reading.

method.name: bytes_capped
method.description: Writes or reads a length, then the bytes. Fails when there are more than [param cap] bytes.

method.name: get_mode
method.description: Returns whether the stream writes, reads or counts.

method.name: int_range
method.description: Writes or reads an integer from [param low] to [param high], using only the bits that range needs. Fails for a value outside the range.

method.name: measurer
method.description: Returns a stream that only counts bits, in [constant MEASURE].

method.name: reader
method.description: Returns a stream that reads [param bytes], in [constant READ].

method.name: string
method.description: Writes or reads a string of at most 1023 UTF-8 bytes.

method.name: svarint
method.description: Like [method varuint], for signed integers. Small negative numbers stay small.

method.name: to_bytes
method.description: Returns the written bytes. Empty when not writing.

method.name: varuint
method.description: Writes or reads an unsigned integer in as few bytes as it needs, at most [param max_bytes]. Small numbers take one byte.

method.name: writer
method.description: Returns an empty stream that writes, in [constant WRITE].

constants.constant: Writes the given values. Read the result with [method to_bytes].
Returns values read from the bytes, ignoring the given values.
Only counts bits. Read the count with [method bit_length].
